title: TEND Record
description: Single evaluation record in train.json / test.json / TEND.json.

record_id.description: Globally unique positive integer; never reused across train/test.

db_id.description: BIRD mini-dev database id; basename of per-db library assets.

canonical.description: L1 canonical NLQ: explicit intent, schema-naive, no NoSQL jargon.

colloquial.description: Underspecified colloquial NLQ at the opposite end of the specificity spectrum.

MQL.description: Representative executable gold MQL; must pass AST_check against canonical_form_set.

mql_signature.description: SHA-256 pin of the canonicalized representative MQL, used to reject duplicate gold queries.

mql_skeleton_signature.description: SHA-256 pin of the field/literal-abstracted MQL skeleton, used to cap repeated query families.

mql_skeleton_summary.description: Human-readable root aggregation stage order, such as $lookup>$addFields>$project.

mechanism.description: Census mechanism selected by the construction coverage slot.

archetype.description: Archetype selected by the construction coverage slot.

diversity_key.description: Planner identity for the schema feature, archetype, and oracle seed used to build this record.

schema_feature.description: Materialized schema-less feature targeted by the coverage slot, such as collection.field or collection.array[].

difficulty.description: NoSQL nativeness tier assigned by NNC; L4 = translation-lossy / NoSQL-native.

sql_infeasibility_class.description: NNC-assigned SQL infeasibility class; gates dual-bridge publish when not feasible.

world_signature.description: SHA-256 pin of mongodb_data/<db_id>.json canonical BSON serialization.

domain_id.description: BIRD domain label for diagnostics and RAR coverage accounting.

join_depth.description: Count of $lookup (or equivalent join) stages in representative MQL.

aggregation_depth.description: Root pipeline stage-count bucket for six-axis coverage.

schema_pattern.description: Primary MongoDB design pattern applied by SRA for this db_id.

schema_flex.description: SRA Stage B heterogenization type; omit or none when H1-H4 do not fire.

_diagnostic_bridge_ref.description: NNC SQL/Template bridge diagnostic verdict (non-publish gate).

property_verification_ref.description: PV property verification and witness probe results.
